# `apps/realmforge/modeler/viewport/RealmForgeSDFViewportRenderer.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/apps/realmforge/modeler/viewport/RealmForgeSDFViewportRenderer.js`

GPU signed-distance presentation for the RealmForge viewport. The editable asset, semantic picking map, camera, and physics stay owned by ModelerViewport. Verified boxes, convex shapes, and closed planar extrusions use exact analytic hits with one shared texture binding; other prototypes receive bounded r32float distance volumes. Both paths use instanced prototype/material batches. Preparation is transactional: an incomplete or failed candidate never replaces the last published GPU presentation.
